structured_output.reason: Cheeses are modeled in Wikidata as instances or subclasses of cheese. The previous query timed out because of two recursive paths. This version uses one-hop P31/P279 and a cheap positive check that the namesake has coordinates.

wikidata.where:
{ ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q10943 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P279 wd:Q10943 . }
?item wdt:P138 ?place .
?place wdt:P625 [] .
FILTER(?item != wd:Q10943)
wikidata.notes: Dropped the recursive P31/P279* paths on both the cheese and place classes. Namesake places are identified by having coordinates (P625), which is a cheap positive constraint. Cheeses whose P138 is missing will not appear.
